text: Men are disturbed not by things, but by the views they take of them.
We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
أَلَا بِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ ٱلْقُلُوبُ — Verily, in the remembrance of God do hearts find rest.
It is not death that a man should fear, but he should fear never beginning to live.
Peace comes from within. Do not seek it without.
Yoga is equanimity. Neither the obedient servant of the senses, nor swept away by gain and loss.
The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts.
He who conquers himself is the mightiest warrior.
If your actions inspire others to dream more, learn more, do more and become more — you are a leader.
To be the best builder on earth, first build the builder — by night: stillness, gratitude, God, sleep.
Do every act of your life as though it were the last act of your life.
source: The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ — Ibn Majah (paraphrase)

text: First say to yourself what you would be; then do what you must do.
